game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the waterfall gate.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonlit Clearing, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the waterfall gate. Each round, bramble beasts strike the waterfall gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the waterfall gate from bramble beasts in Moonlit Clearing: keep the pattern_rows meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: pattern_rows drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
